title: MYSTIC BALLOON
author: TEAM a.r.g.; CHGame port
description: Mystic Balloon with Pastel Island colors, a continuous 128x128 splash illustration and a full scrolling world. Choose Color, Original B&W, Game Boy DMG, or Amber in CONF. Explore 39 original levels.

buttons.action: Look; UP enters an unlocked door
Jump; press again in the air and hold to float; back in menus
Inhale enemies and coins; accept in menus
Pause or resume; hold 3 seconds for the game menu
